name: Amnion River
source:
"Amnion River" is a visual novel following Lis, a young thief from Whitecalder trying to rekindle her long-lost passion for painting, as she deals with her declining health and recurring nightmares. One day, a nameless young girl with unusual, reddish skin, snow-white hair and no clear memory of her past enters her life seemingly out of nowhere. Lis decides to take her in and names her Clair, a name she vaguely feels befits her perfectly. 

As the struggling Lis takes care of her three-legged dog, Toni, and the mysterious Clair, her condition worsens, and she slowly begins to lose touch with reality. Knowing she doesn’t have much time left, she decides to return to her horrid past to find answers about the mysterious death of her dear older sister, Leonore, fourteen years ago.

[From [url=https://sylzebub.itch.io/amnion-river]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Amnion River》是一部视觉小说，讲述了来自Whitecalder的年轻小偷Lis的故事，她试图重新点燃她失去已久的绘画热情，同时应对自己日益恶化的健康状况和反复出现的噩梦。有一天，一位皮肤异常红润、头发雪白、对过去没有清晰记忆的无名少女突然闯入了她的生活。莉丝决定收留她，并给她取名克莱尔，她隐约觉得这个名字非常适合她。

当挣扎的莉丝照顾她的三足狗托尼和神秘的克莱尔时，她的病情恶化，她慢慢开始与现实脱节。她知道自己的时间不多了，决定回到可怕的过去，寻找十四年前她亲爱的姐姐莱昂诺尔神秘死亡的答案。
